svg.title: H09 PERSEVERANCE LAKE ARCHIVE engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram separates directly observed features from composition/optical-size inference and explicitly carries p(M), transport and alteration. Common-footprint validation limits geological grain-size and paleolake interpretation to supported scenarios.
